title: stacking rectangle bento boxes
text: stacking rectangle bento boxes. I purchased two of these.  They are plastic - one solid piece.  Wash by hand only.  They are very long, rectangle shape with many compartments. They do stack, I place paper towels between them to prevent scratches.  I was super disappointed in my so called prime delivery - no fault of the selling entity.  They did come in a really old reused box.  They were lost for a very long time and showed out for delivery for literally days.  They obviously eventually arrived - but way late and in fact the selling entity opened an investigation.  I just wish I was getting the delivery I paid for!  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ebros Red And Black Traditional Japanese Large Bento Box With Dividers 6 Compartments Lacquered Copolymer Plastic Serving or Display Platter Tray 14" by 9.25" Made In Japan Dining Dinner Serveware (5)
features: This is a high quality copolymer plastic lacquer Japanese takeout bento box style platter. The platter has six compartments as pictured; five for entrees/side dishes and one for wasabi/condiments in the center. Serve yourself or your guests sushi, sashimi, stir fried entrees, soup and dessert all in this bento box platter. This bento box is not only stylish but it is also very functional and practical.
The bento box serving platter measures 2" deep, 14" long and 9.25" wide approximately. It weighs about 14 ounces each.

This Plastic Lacquer Bento Platter is made in a state of the art factory in Japan. Made of Copolymer plastic, this aesthetic traditional bento box has a high resistance to breakage, scratches and stains. It has a quick dry time and can be used in both the microwave and dishwasher. Co-polymer material can handle temperatures from 40°F to 210°F, therefore this platter must not be stored in freezers.
This listing selection is for a pack of 5 bento boxes.
